anchors.contains: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India
No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years
The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed.
No person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law.
Parliament may in exercise of its constituent power amend by way of addition, variation or repeal any provision of this Constitution
If the President, on receipt of a report from the Governor *** of a State or otherwise
every High Court shall have power
to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions
India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States.
unity and integrity of the Nation
